input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to `http://localhost:3000` when the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set, and that fallback is being used to build the password reset link (and other email links) in production. Either PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, or the fallback is masking a misconfiguration since last week's release. The fix should ensure PUBLIC_URL is set correctly in production, and consider making the lack of it a hard failure for link-generation code rather than silently defaulting to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is being used to build the password reset link (and other links such as the rollup report and scheduled export links). In production this environment variable is apparently missing or misconfigured, so users receive emails pointing at localhost instead of the real public URL.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL (or an equivalent production config value, e.g. config.publicUrl) is always set correctly in the deployment environment, and consider making BASE_URL derive from a required config value rather than silently falling back to localhost, so a missing configuration fails loudly instead of producing broken links in emails.
